Students do a lot of studying. They spend many hours every day going to school and various learning institutes.
They study so hard because competition for a place at top universities is intense.
Because of this, students don't have a lot of time for sports. When they do have free time, many choose to play online games.
Online gaming is very popular. Game arcades are almost everywhere you look in big cities.
Gaming is also big business. International video game revenue was estimated to be $81.5 billion in 2014.
Some professional gamers have become celebrities. The highest-paid players can earn up to $15,000 per month!
But there is a dark side. Many doctors and scientists say that gaming addiction is a big social problem.
In 2010, a baby starved to death while her parents obsessively played an online game at an internet café.
In other cases, people have collapsed and died in internet cafés after playing games for 50 hours or more.
Many other young people waste time playing games. They could spend that time studying, exercising, socializing with real people, or just relaxing.
The South Korean government knew about the problem and proposed several solutions.
First, it paid a lot of money to set up hospitals that treat game addiction. There, game addicts could get special treatment.
Schools also offered classes about the dangers of gaming addiction.
In 2011, Korea made a law that regulated online games: from midnight to 6 a.m., children under 16 could not play.
Many people opposed it. Critics said families should decide for themselves. In 2021, the law ended.
Everyone agreed with the new law.

Hines Ward is a famous Korean-American football player. He is recognized as one of the best players in the sport. However, success was not easy for him.

When Hines was two, his father left. His mother raised him alone, but she couldn't speak English well.
At school, he didn't fit in, and kids made fun of him. In high school he found football, and his coach pushed him to succeed.
In 1998, he was drafted into the NFL. He played for the Pittsburgh Steelers until 2011 and won two Super Bowls.
In 2006, he visited Korea to help biracial children. His charity gives them free classes and sports.

Christmas is an important Christian holiday. It is celebrated around the world every December 25th. Originally, it was a holy day that celebrated the birth of Jesus Christ.
Many people go to church on Christmas Eve or Christmas Day. Most people also visit relatives, cook a special dinner, and exchange gifts.
Gift-giving is now the most famous Christmas tradition. Families spend lots of money on presents, and December is the busiest month for stores and shopping websites.
Factories around the world work overtime in the fall, producing Christmas cards and decorations. Many of them are in China, which isn't even a Christian country.
Another feature of Christmas is seemingly endless advertising. Months before the holiday, store windows are filled with Santa Clauses and decorations.
TV and radio ads remind consumers to buy presents. This is good news for businesses. Still, many people say the focus on profit has ruined the holiday.
